notes: 14 actual original PostgreSQL staging/swap cases cover retention/catchup overrides, empty staged channels, first-start boundaries, orphan/live mapping rules, literal unmapped staged insertion, bounded move batches and transaction rollback.

Private session holds4-worker admission and caller-provided job guard. Each SQL operation owns its connection and guard until actual reply; aborting a table-locked waiter retains guard until query/commit completion.
Existing guide payloads remain in SQL; range processing uses1000IDs, insert move batches<=5000, stage batches<=2500rows/8MiB. Explicit total/mapped-ID caps remain resource guards.
Initial runner import and assumed-table-name fixture errors are retained; original schema names were verified before successful native comparison.
No HTTP refresh dispatch, complete ingestion job, lock-loss/cancel policy, SQL-failure retry orchestration or full job resource acceptance yet.
